evals.prompt: Review a legacy V1-style proposal that needs migration to a FlashDreams V2 binding. New code is in integrations/my_model/my_model/runner.py and registers [project.entry-points."flashdreams.runner_configs"] my-model="my_model.runner:RUNNER". It should bind a reusable apps/my_demo app to my_model. Supply the corrected in-tree layout and manifest entry-point fragment, not a full implementation. Use the FlashDreams source and docs provided at /workspace/repo as reference. Do not install dependencies, download model assets, run generation or build a bundle.
evals.expected_output: Places model code/config/tests under integrations_v2/my_model and its adapter under apps/my_demo/adapter.py inside that model package. Registers a zero-argument create_app factory in flashdreams.applications_v2, declares the reusable app dependency and includes adapter modules in packaging. Does not introduce a RunnerConfig for the V2 binding.
assertions: Uses flashdreams.applications_v2 with an adapter:create_app target.
Keeps the dependency from integration to app and mentions packaging the adapter.
Rejects the legacy runner.py and flashdreams.runner_configs pattern for this V2 binding.

evals.prompt: I am porting weights into FlashDreams. Source checkpoint keys a and b both rename to weight; c renames to bias. The model expects weight and bias with matching tensor shapes. My check compares only the destination key set and passes. Is this sufficient? Give a CPU-safe validation plan without loading real weights. Use the FlashDreams source and docs provided at /workspace/repo as reference. Do not install dependencies, download model assets, run generation or build a bundle.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the transform silently overwrites a tensor, so matching destination sets/shapes do not prove a bijection. Check duplicate destinations/cardinality, missing and unexpected keys, and shapes using metadata/meta tensors through the actual transform, plus representative key tests.
assertions: Identifies the a/b collision and possible dictionary overwrite.
Adds duplicate-destination/cardinality checking along with key and shape checks.
Uses metadata or meta tensors rather than GPU allocation or a full weight download.

evals.prompt: A proposed FlashDreams model port makes apps/t2v import my_model.config and makes flashdreams.infra import my_model to register its preset. Where should the model defaults and registration live instead, and how should app tests and model integration tests be separated? This is a design review; do not edit files. Use the FlashDreams source and docs provided at /workspace/repo as reference. Do not install dependencies, download model assets, run generation or build a bundle.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the app and shared framework model-independent. The model integration owns config and an adapter under integrations_v2/my_model/apps/t2v/adapter.py; its package depends on the reusable app and exposes the V2 factory entry point. App tests use stubs; model checks live in integration tests.
assertions: Moves concrete defaults and binding to the integration adapter.
Separates app stub tests from model integration tests.

evals.prompt: Review this FlashDreams V2 adapter lifecycle: create_app() downloads weights; session_desc() compiles kernels; the first model step imports a native extension and fetches missing assets. Where should one-time preparation happen, when must it finish, and what can a CPU parser check prove? Use the FlashDreams source and docs provided at /workspace/repo as reference. Do not install dependencies, download model assets, run generation or build a bundle.
evals.expected_output: Keeps factory and description cheap; completes downloads, compilation/native loading and model construction within IApplication.init, waiting for any preparation workers before returning. Starting a worker in init does not exempt later operations from the preparation guard. Steps consume prepared state; parser checks do not prove checkpoint correctness, GPU execution or parity.
assertions: Requires one-time preparation to finish before IApplication.init returns rather than merely starting work there.
Keeps create_app and session_desc free of model loading.
Distinguishes parser validation from generation and parity evidence.

evals.prompt: The FlashDreams model and preset are already installed. I only need the command to save one generated clip; I am not adding or changing a model.
evals.expected_output: Handles the existing-model launch request without loading the model integration skill.
assertions: Does not load or apply flashdreams-integrate-model.
Does not propose a new package or adapter.
